title: Credo (Sermisy, Missa Voulant honneur)
desc: Claudin de Sermisy, Missa Voulant honneur, Credo, 1556. 4 voices (Superius, Contratenor, Tenor, Bassus), each on its own staff. Note values as in the edition (whole note = semibreve), at the original pitch; editorial accidentals small above the staff.
